title: Choose the new CoWin homepage world
question: All four options keep real products and sales clarity. Choose the visual world that should lead the final homepage build.

options.label: Departure Motion
options.lineage: airport wayfinding, boarding passes and technical travel gear
options.thesis: A moving departure board turns each CoWin model into a clear route for music, travel or creation.
options.viewport: A cobalt route field carries the main proposition while G200 and V03-T5 appear as two departure choices with real prices and direct CTAs.
options.risk: Wayfinding details must stay subordinate or the page can feel like an airline service.

options.label: Colorblock Run Club
options.lineage: modular Dutch identity systems and contemporary run-club graphics
options.thesis: Real product photography and saturated modular bars make the catalogue feel like wearable street equipment.
options.viewport: A large G200 photograph crosses a hard grid while colored bars label Move, Listen and Explore; two compact price cards remain immediately actionable.
options.risk: Too many equal colors could weaken the hierarchy unless one color owns each section.
options.case: Wins audience identification through fashion energy; product clarity stays strong because every band maps to a use case.

options.label: Kinetic Lens Field
options.lineage: experiential media portals and lens-refraction light fields
options.thesis: The homepage behaves like light passing through a lens, with products suspended inside a responsive field.
options.viewport: An oversized G200 floats over a deep moving light field, with the proposition and two grounded product choices held in a precise lower rail.
options.risk: Highest production and performance cost; the atmospheric field can outrun ecommerce clarity if overused.
options.case: Strongest technology impression, but weaker immediate product comparison than Departure Motion.

options.label: Street Sprint Zine
options.lineage: independent sport zines, race flyers and torn campaign posters
options.thesis: A graphic race-day collage makes CoWin feel young, fast and unapologetically wearable.
options.viewport: A cropped cyclist and G200 cutout collide with the main proposition; launch price and Shop now sit on clean white ticket panels.
options.risk: Fuses poorly with premium everyday frames if the torn-paper language is used beyond campaign moments.
options.case: Highest youth and sport energy, but the narrowest cross-category reach for the full catalogue.

canonCard.label: Premium category standard
canonCard.thesis: A familiar luxury-tech storefront executed with restrained typography, a clean split hero and polished product photography.
canonCard.viewport: Editorial copy and a single large product share the first viewport, followed by two conventional featured-product cards.
canonCard.risk: Easy to trust and shop, but less ownable and more similar to established eyewear and consumer-tech brands.
